title: Retire six writing rules into unplaceable-reference
summary: Six writing rules — bare-reference, reference-without-label, reference-without-link, chat-local-reference, undefined-name and undefined-name-at-start — are deleted and folded into the single unplaceable-reference rule, which now also warns on a labelled repository reference that carries no link. Because the old ids can no longer fire, every place a user could still name one (a suppression marker, a writing.levels override, an osf-expect declaration, osf explain, the OSF_WRITING_CHAT_LOCAL_LABELS variable, the writing.chat_local_labels config key) is turned into an error or notice that names the replacement instead of failing silently.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: main.rs
nodes.summary: Dispatches lint, verify and explain; explain now short-circuits a retired rule id to its replacement.

nodes.label: Config loader
nodes.subtitle: config.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves file, environment and flag layers. Drops writing.chat_local_labels, notices the retired env var, and rejects a writing.levels key naming a retired rule.

nodes.label: RETIRED_RULE_IDS
nodes.subtitle: &[(&str, &str)]
nodes.summary: The single table mapping each of the six retired ids to unplaceable-reference. Every migration message in the change reads from it.

nodes.label: verify runner
nodes.subtitle: verify.rs
nodes.summary: Pre-commit and pre-push checks; turns a declared fixture's retired rule id into an expectation-retired-rule error.

nodes.label: Suppression engine
nodes.subtitle: suppress.rs
nodes.summary: Parses osf-disable markers and validates their rule ids. A retired id is still an error, but the message names the replacement.

nodes.label: Expectation check
nodes.subtitle: expectation.rs
nodes.summary: Compares an osf-expect declaration against the findings actually produced. A declared retired id lands in a new retired bucket rather than missing.

nodes.label: Human / SARIF renderers
nodes.subtitle: human.rs, sarif.rs
nodes.summary: Unchanged behaviour; only their test fixtures moved to the new rule id.

nodes.label: lint_writing
nodes.subtitle: writing/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Runs the sentence, paragraph and document rules, resolves each finding's level and remediation from its own evidence, then applies suppressions with the retired table.

nodes.label: unplaceable-reference
nodes.subtitle: rules.rs
nodes.summary: The surviving reference rule. Now also emits a warning for a labelled repository reference with no link, the job the retired reference-without-link rule did.

nodes.label: Six retired rules
nodes.subtitle: bare-reference, chat-local-reference, undefined-name, …
nodes.summary: bare-reference, reference-without-label, reference-without-link, chat-local-reference, undefined-name and undefined-name-at-start are deleted from the rule set and their metadata removed.

nodes.label: RULE_META
nodes.subtitle: writing/meta.rs
nodes.summary: Per-rule class, group and prose. The six retired entries are gone; unplaceable-reference's description now covers the unlinked-reference warning.

nodes.label: Writing fixtures
nodes.subtitle: tests/fixtures/writing
nodes.summary: Declarations of the retired ids are stripped, the repo-qualified placeable fixture gains a link, and a new unlinked-reference fixture is added.

nodes.label: dsh adapter
nodes.subtitle: integrations/dsh
nodes.summary: Reads osf's exit code and stderr; its refusal-reason test now quotes the new rule id.

nodes.label: omp adapter
nodes.subtitle: integrations/omp

nodes.label: opencode adapter

nodes.summary: Same decision-JSON contract as omp; its refusal-reason test now quotes the new rule id.

edges.label: lint writing
edges.summary: The lint subcommand hands the document to the writing rule set.
Every run resolves its config before linting.

edges.label: reject retired levels
edges.summary: A writing.levels key naming a retired rule is now an error naming unplaceable-reference, read straight from the shared table.

edges.label: known + retired ids
edges.summary: Suppression now receives the retired table so a marker naming an old id explains the replacement.
The one surviving reference rule now covers what the six retired rules caught.
The six old rules are no longer invoked from the rule list.
Level and remediation are resolved from each finding's own evidence, not special-cased per rule id.

edges.label: retired table
edges.summary: A declared fixture's retired id becomes an expectation-retired-rule error naming the replacement.
The retired table is passed in so a retired declaration is bucketed separately from a missing one.

edges.label: osf explain
edges.summary: explain short-circuits a retired id to its replacement instead of reporting no such rule.
Fixture declarations were rewritten to the surviving rule id.

edges.label: exit code + stderr

edges.label: decision JSON

edges.label: decision JSON
edges.summary: Same contract as the omp adapter.

flows.title: A retired rule id is named after the change
flows.summary: Every path a user can still name one of the six deleted ids now resolves to a message pointing at unplaceable-reference, instead of a silent no-op or a bare 'not a rule id'.
